🤖 dddmr navigation

 Next-Generation 3D Autonomous Navigation for Mobile Robots & Quadrupeds 

 
 
 
 Quadruped robot navigating across multiple floors and stairs in Gazebo & RViz with real-time YOLO + TensorRT stair segmentation 

 dddmr navigation (3D Mobile Robot Navigation) is a complete, end-to-end 3D navigation stack engineered to conquer complex, multi-level, and unstructured 3D environments where traditional 2D navigation frameworks fall short. From multi-floor buildings and steep ramps to staircases, dddmr navigation empowers wheeled and legged robots to map, localize, plan, and navigate autonomously in true 3D space.

 [!NOTE]
 dddmr navigation is designed to solve the challenges that Nav2 cannot handle—including multi-layer floor mapping and localization, 3D path planning in stereo structures, ramp and stair traversal, and dynamic perception markings and clearings directly in a 3D point cloud map.

---

 🪜 Milestone Showcase: Multi-Floor Quadruped Stair Navigation (YOLO + TensorRT)

Bringing all layers of dddmr navigation together, our latest milestone achieves autonomous multi-floor navigation across staircases for quadruped robots .

Together with dddmr navigation 's 3D localization, multi-floor global path planning, real-time obstacle avoidance, and locomotion control, the robot dog autonomously navigates from start to goal across multiple floors and staircases.

👉 Let's play Lite3 stair navigation using dddmr navigation
